scope: DLC presentation consumers and Future Saga content-map identity resolution
evidence_boundary: This audit proves deterministic DLC identity resolution and consumer navigation references only. It does not claim that every listed content domain has a populated concrete record.
rules: Canonical DLC identity remains the source of truth for dlc_id resolution.
Future Saga Chapters 1-4 remain individual canonical identities; the parent bundle is grouping metadata only.
Presentation consumers cannot create or rename canonical DLC relationships.
Missing downstream content remains unresolved rather than inferred.
